issues.description: Method return type mismatch for Lecture.getTotalNumberOfStudents(): the UML in problem_statement.md declares getTotalNumberOfStudents() with return type String, but the reference implementation in solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java implements getTotalNumberOfStudents() as returning int. The template prompts students to implement this method (TODO 2.4) but does not provide a signature, so students guided by the UML may implement the wrong return type. This inconsistency can cause compilation errors or failing behavior in other methods that use a numeric total (e.g., getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor performs numeric division) and will confuse students which return type is correct.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent across artifacts. Prefer changing the UML and any textual references in problem_statement.md to declare getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int (and update the PlantUML line). This matches the numeric usage in other methods (e.g., getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor) and the reference solution. If a String is intentionally required, update the solution and template to return a String and adjust dependent methods accordingly (e.g., parse or convert to int where numeric operations are needed).
